THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 18 · Collapsed cavern and Vhalak
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Water spills down into a broad rift. Ropes hang from stakes along its western edge, while the clack of shifted rubble rises from below. Figures work under the eye of a dark-clad supervisor.

The waterfall fills the rift with a steady roar, broken by the clacking work below. Ropes fastened to stakes on the western side offer a visible means of descent. From the edge, you can examine their condition and the figures beneath before committing to the drop.

Ask the players

Do you observe from cover, talk, descend, or stop the excavation? Who can reach each rope?
